strings.string: This workout is older than all 100 saved workouts, so it wasn't added. History keeps only the 100 most recent.
Congratulations! You finished the program. Keep running #40, or pick #1 to start over.
Running more than once a day is not recommended.
Running more than six days a week is not recommended.
Press Start to open the link on your phone.

40 workouts of running and walking.|Each starts with a 5-minute warm-up walk and ends with a 5-minute cool-down walk.|Run at most once a day, 4 to 6 times a week.|Saved workouts sync to Garmin Connect as runs.||Check with your doctor before starting a running program.
#1 R1 W1 ×3 means run 1 min, walk 1 min, 3 times.|No W: no walk.|No ×: once.|Second line: total time, including warm-up and cool-down.|* marks the recommended workout.
Rate how each workout felt. Your next workout:|Bad: back one.|OK: same one.|Good: next one.|Great: skip one.
Full days between your last run and today move you back after the rating:|Ran Monday, today Thursday: 2 days off.|0 to 2: no change.|3: back one.|4: back two.|5: back three.|6+: restart at #1.
Before a workout you may see a warning:|Once per day: you already ran today.|Six per week: you ran each of the last 6 days.|Continue shows the next warning, or starts the workout. Cancel goes back.

During a workout:|Start: pause or resume.|Back: pause.|Back while paused: the End workout? menu.|Resume: keep going.|Save: keep it and rate it.|Discard: delete it. Nothing is logged.|After the cool-down it ends and asks How did it feel?|Up and Down change the rating. Start picks it. Back stays on this screen.
